BiblicalUsage: This word is used once, for the oppression Jeremiah forbids the king of Judah. Execute ye judgment and righteousness, he says, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for the oppressor carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the command, that the king's first duty is to deliver the spoiled from the hand of the man who presses them down.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
